text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I thought I heard someone calling my 
name...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a statue of the Three Goddesses. Since 
I'm here, might as well say a little 
prayer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over everyone so they can do 
their best without getting hurt...!
